reason: Initial pure-array implementation used NumPy multinomial group counts. The sealed INFERENCE_RANDOMNESS_LOCK specifies PCG64 integer-index draws. The two are distributionally equivalent but have different deterministic streams.
correction: Use explicit numpy.random.Generator(numpy.random.PCG64(24681357)), integers(0, n_groups, size=(2048, n_groups), dtype=int64) on ascending unique group IDs, and count each draw with bincount.
scope: No INNER person arrays, labels, candidate outcomes, or interval run were read by R4 before this correction. The finite K, endpoint signs, full-K critical, and seed-mean rule are unchanged.
test: Data-free synthetic test compares all 2048 group-count rows to the locked PCG64 integer stream.
